Handoff 2026-11-17 ~19:45 KST from the harness common-ization discussion lead (epic 261114-epic-ws-common-session-foundation; whiteboard swingerpuristcloverunsaved). Owner went home and resumes later; the perf main session holds this.

LANDED on develop (pushed): 6615ab3f6 hosted application layer (prompt-assembly, compaction-lifecycle, child-session-entry); 1d04941a6 ws/agent.* + ws/exec.* tool schemas, new 261117-feat-ws-exec-mux-terminal, 261112 dropped, pi.* spawn tools hidden now / handlers removed next minor ((54)=b). The commit carrying this note settles (55)-(63): agent.interrupt added, agent.stop removed, no auto-close (agents sleep after idle_timeout 600 s and wake on mail), fifth session state 'child agent waiting' deleted 15 days after last activity, control key = spawn address with an ownership error, cap counts awake agents, mailbox.send always steer with next-turn fallback, holder version coexistence ((56): old holder drains on the N-1 protocol).

OPEN OWNER QUESTION: (53) agent.spawn presets - assumed 'a' (no presets; built-in profiles stay internal to leads/dashboard; the authority enum replaces profile). Recorded in the Open Decision Queue of 261117-feat-ws-agent-tools-mailbox-routing. Confirm or change, then settle it into Decisions.

CATALOG PROMOTION (261117-feat-ws-harness-capability-catalog to ready): if it is not on develop when you read this, it is on branch tickets/catalog-promote in worktree .ws-worktrees/devenv/junkie-barbed-fracture (worker key unissued-ultimate-hurray), uncommitted. Design fixes 1-8 plus the (30) interrupt/follow-up items and the (31)=a Decision 6 cross-ref are applied; an opus delta design review was running at 19:45. Remaining: tickets.sage_stamp stage combined (delta design verdict + retained completeness pass with 5 minors), tickets.move ready, git.commit, rebase onto develop, ff-only, push, worktree.release, branch -d.
